decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir is a hardware product in the firm's core water-control business, launched only in 2024, and such products usually have long market lives.
The energy management system is a digital offering outside the core hardware, and the firm already dropped similar digital and fouling products within a year, but it is too new to drop yet.
The overflow flap gate is a core water-level regulation product with its own website page, which signals strong commitment.
